author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand explores a growing trend in modern culture—where everyone seems to have an opinion, a platform, and the confidence to speak on anything. With constant access to information and social media, expertise can feel diluted, and the line between knowledge and noise becomes harder to distinguish. The result is a world where strong opinions spread faster than understanding.
